Syllabus Map.Subject: Engineering Mathematics
Syllabus Map.Topics Included:
Matrix algebra, systems of linear equations, eigenvalues/eigenvectors
Limits, continuity, differentiability, mean value theorem, indeterminate forms
Definite/improper integrals; double/triple integrals
Partial derivatives, total derivative, Taylor series, maxima/minima
Vector calculus: gradient, divergence, curl, line/surface/volume integrals
First/higher order DE, Euler-Cauchy, IVP/BVP, Laplace transform
Complex variables: analytic functions, CR equations, Cauchy theorem/formula, Taylor/Laurent
Probability/statistics: conditional probability, mean/SD, random variables, binomial/Poisson/normal
Numerical methods: algebraic equations, trapezoidal/Simpson, ODE methods

Syllabus Map.Subject: General Aptitude
Syllabus Map.Topics Included:
Verbal aptitude: grammar, vocabulary, sentence completion, critical reasoning
Numerical aptitude: percentages, ratios, averages, time-work, speed-distance
Data interpretation and logical reasoning practice

Syllabus Map.Subject: Engineering Mechanics
Syllabus Map.Topics Included:
FBD, equilibrium, friction applications, trusses/frames
Kinematics/dynamics of rigid bodies, impulse/momentum, energy methods, virtual work

Syllabus Map.Subject: Mechanics of Materials
Syllabus Map.Topics Included:
Stress-strain, elastic constants, Poisson's ratio, Mohr's circle
Thin cylinders, SFD/BMD, bending/shear stress, shear centre
Beam deflection, torsion of shafts, Euler columns, energy methods
Thermal stress, strain gauges/rosettes, UTM, hardness and impact testing

Syllabus Map.Subject: Theory of Machines
Syllabus Map.Topics Included:
Mechanism displacement/velocity/acceleration analysis
Dynamic analysis, cams, gears and gear trains
Flywheels/governors, balancing, gyroscope

Syllabus Map.Subject: Vibrations
Syllabus Map.Topics Included: Free/forced vibration SDOF, damping, isolation, resonance, critical speed

Syllabus Map.Subject: Machine Design
Syllabus Map.Topics Included:
Static/dynamic loading, failure theories, fatigue, S-N diagram
Bolted/riveted/welded joints; shafts, gears, bearings, brakes/clutches, springs

Syllabus Map.Section: Section 3: Fluid Mechanics and Thermal Sciences
Syllabus Map.Subject: Fluid Mechanics
Syllabus Map.Topics Included:
Fluid properties, statics, submerged/floating bodies
Control-volume mass/momentum/energy, Bernoulli equation
Continuity/momentum differential equations, dimensional analysis
Viscous incompressible flow, boundary layer, turbulent flow
Pipe flow, head losses, bends/fittings, basics of compressible flow

Syllabus Map.Section: Section 3: Fluid Mechanics and Thermal Sciences
Syllabus Map.Subject: Heat Transfer
Syllabus Map.Topics Included:
Modes, 1D conduction, resistance analogy, fins
Unsteady conduction, lumped system, Heisler charts
Convective heat transfer, boundary layers, correlations over plates/pipes
Heat exchangers: LMTD and NTU methods
Radiation: Stefan-Boltzmann, Wien law, black/grey surfaces, view factors, networks

Syllabus Map.Section: Section 3: Fluid Mechanics and Thermal Sciences
Syllabus Map.Subject: Thermodynamics
Syllabus Map.Topics Included:
Systems/processes, pure substances, ideal/real gases
Zeroth/first law, work/heat calculations
Second law, entropy, property charts/tables
Availability, irreversibility, thermodynamic relations

Syllabus Map.Section: Section 3: Fluid Mechanics and Thermal Sciences
Syllabus Map.Subject: Applications
Syllabus Map.Topics Included:
Compressors, vapor/gas power cycles, regeneration and reheat
IC engines: Otto, Diesel and dual cycles
Refrigeration/AC: vapor/gas refrigeration, heat pumps, psychrometrics
Turbomachinery: velocity diagrams, Pelton/Francis/Kaplan, steam/gas turbines

Syllabus Map.Section: Section 4: Materials, Manufacturing and Industrial Engineering
Syllabus Map.Subject: Engineering Materials
Syllabus Map.Topics Included: Structure/properties, phase diagrams, heat treatment, stress-strain diagrams

Syllabus Map.Section: Section 4: Materials, Manufacturing and Industrial Engineering
Syllabus Map.Subject: Manufacturing
Syllabus Map.Topics Included:
Casting: patterns/moulds/cores, solidification, riser/gating design
Forming: yield criteria, hot/cold working, forging/rolling/extrusion/drawing/sheet forming
Joining: welding, brazing, soldering, adhesive bonding, powder metallurgy
Machining: mechanics, tools, geometry/materials, tool life/wear, economics
Non-traditional machining, jigs/fixtures, abrasive machining, NC/CNC programming
Metrology: limits/fits/tolerances, comparators, interferometry, CMM
CIM: CAD/CAM integration, additive manufacturing

Syllabus Map.Section: Section 4: Materials, Manufacturing and Industrial Engineering
Syllabus Map.Subject: Industrial Engineering/OR
Syllabus Map.Topics Included:
PPC: forecasting, aggregate planning, scheduling, MRP, lean manufacturing
Inventory: deterministic models, safety stock
OR: linear programming/simplex, transportation, assignment
OR: network flow, queuing, PERT/CPM
